# Frame-keyed pad script that drives the determinism harness into an ACTUAL
# MATCH, which is the workload every perf A/B in this project has lacked: the
# old boot-menu.txt run carries ~0.1% of a session's paired-single traffic, so
# an instruction-count comparison there measures a workload that does not
# contain the thing being optimised.
#
# Route (frames from scouting, work/pipe-input/scout-frames.sh):
#   300-2400  START mash   logos, the intro movie, the title screen
#   2251      MODE SELECT, Arcade already highlighted
#   2600-4400 spaced A     Arcade -> character select (Talim) -> stage intro
#   ~4500     BATTLE 1, Talim vs Manghua on the bridge stage
#   4500+     a fixed attack/step pattern so the fight keeps going; an idle
#             player just loses and parks on a continue prompt.
#
# START is deliberately absent after 2400: in a match it opens the pause menu,
# which stops the emulation being a benchmark of anything.
# frame  buttons   stick_x stick_y

#
#        0 -  4,500   boot, intro movie, title, mode select, character select
#    4,500 - 63,500   Arcade stages 1-7, roughly 8,000 frames each
#   63,500 - ~70,000  STAGE 8 vs INFERNO  <- the content that misses 60 fps
#  ~70,800            ending / victory screen
#  ~82,700            name-entry ranking screen, 69 fps
#
# Frames 63,500-70,000 are the reason this file exists. Every A/B in this
# project before it -- PGO, BOLT, layout, the LLVM backend -- was scored on
# stages 1-2, which is the easy content: the Deck holds 73 fps there and only
# 50.5 fps against Inferno.
#
# The original stops at 39,988, which reaches roughly stage 5. Measured
# on the Deck with P1 Infinite Health enabled: ~8,000 frames per stage,
# stage 1 cleared by ~frame 11,000 and stage 2 underway at 13,337. Eight
# stages therefore needs ~68,000 frames; this runs to 100,000 for slack,
# because later opponents block more and take longer to finish.
#
# REQUIRES the Action Replay code 'P1 Infinite Health' to be enabled, or
# the run can lose and the route stops being deterministic. Enable it by
# writing the name under [ActionReplay_Enabled] in GameSettings/GRSEAF.ini:
# the in-game CHEATS tab only calls ApplyCodes() in memory and never
# persists, so toggling it there does nothing for a scripted run.
# 'P1 Win 1 Round To Win' roughly halves the frames needed.
